offering_description.value: Provides mobile power generation and bulk sand logistics equipment and services to oil and gas producers and oilfield service companies, and increasingly to data center developers. Most equipment is rented and operated on customer sites under multi-year contracts.

primary_products.value: mobile gas turbine power generators; proppant storage and handling equipment

primary_services.value: power generation operation; proppant logistics; equipment maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas producers, oilfield service companies, data center developers, industrial power users

end_markets.value: oil and gas; data centers; industrial power

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: turbine generators and handling equipment rented to customers; service fees: equipment operation, sand logistics and maintenance

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs mobile power and proppant handling fleets, sold to energy producers and data center developers; service provider: operates equipment on customer well sites and facilities

geography_served.value: US national: Permian Basin and other major US onshore oil and gas regions

specialization.value: related lines: mobile power generation and proppant logistics sharing oilfield and power customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: oil and gas operators and data center developers under contract

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: air emissions permits for turbines and environmental, safety and transport rules for sand logistics

notes: Business mix has shifted over time, so this reflects the current power and logistics focus and may lag recent changes.
